      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:

                name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Assigned

              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key

                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and householdId
                components are empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:

              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last
                name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Assigned
                only when the create request opts in with sharesHousehold=true; otherwise null.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and householdId
                components are empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, computed on creation.
                Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped
                at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

                address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - PHONE

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

              items:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits
            and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
            fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present
            it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last
                name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Assigned
                only when the create request opts in with sharesHousehold=true; otherwise null.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through,
                formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and householdId
                components are empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, computed on creation.
                Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped
                at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel; 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email
                address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the same
                business day as this owner's registrationDate, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the `ageBand` derivation for `POST /api/owners` (returned via `GET /api/owners/{id}`), satisfying the spec that when the request includes an ISO `birthDate`, the response returns `ageBand` as `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), or `SENIOR` (65+), computed against `registrationDate`.

Changes:

- **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `birthDate` (ISO date) input to the `OwnerFields` schema, and a read-only `ageBand` enum (`MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`) to the `Owner` response schema. The DTOs (`OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerDto`, `OwnerDto.AgeBandEnum`) are generated from this spec at build time.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the persisted `birthDate` field (`birth_date` column) with getter/setter, so the value survives create→GET.
- **`schema.sql`** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the `birth_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. Tests run on the hsqldb profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to be declared.
- **`util/AgeBand.java`** — new helper computing the band from `Period.between(birthDate, registrationDate).getYears()`, returning `null` when no birth date is present.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a MapStruct mapping that computes `ageBand` from the entity's `birthDate`/`registrationDate` (yielding `null`, and thus an absent field, when no birth date was supplied). `birthDate` itself auto-maps by name from request→entity→response.

The wiring reuses the existing owner pipeline: `BuildOwner` runs `ownerMapper.toOwner(request)` (carrying `birthDate`), `SaveOwner` persists it, and the GET responder's `toOwnerDto` derives `ageBand`. No new function classes or YAML steps were needed since the value is derived, not validated.

Tests: `AcceptanceTest` (which posts `birthDate: 1990-01-01` and asserts `ageBand == ADULT` against the 2026 registration date) and the full suite both pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
